Title: {LSJ} Using Master Phase Actions in the Storyline

Messages.Author: The Kaiser
Messages.Body:
I have the following rules question pertaining to the storyline:

The newest rules update states:

"12. Any Methuselah can use a master phase action to put a manipulation
counter on Reverend Adams. During the referendum to change control of
Reverend Adams, each manipulation counter represents a vote in favor of
the referendum. Burn all manipulation counters whenever control of
Reverend Adams changes."

If you generate more than one master phase action in a given master
phase, can you put more than one manipulation counter on Reverend
Adams?  

Many thanks in advance.

TTFn
